profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Cohesity | Full-Stack Engineer | Enterprise Systems, APIs & AI Products | Builder + Problem Solver
profile.summary:
I like figuring out how things work — and how they could work better.
 
I'm a Software Engineer II at Cohesity with experience building across the application stack, from user interfaces and APIs to backend systems, databases, and platform integrations.
 
Earlier in my software career, I worked on enterprise data-protection software integrating with VMware APIs for virtual machine backup and recovery, developing in C++ and Java, working with PostgreSQL schemas, and building UI functionality.
 
Today, I build software for enterprise AI-powered products, with much of my work focused on creating the application experiences that connect users with complex underlying systems. I'm currently expanding that work into metrics and application visibility.
 
Before becoming a software engineer, I worked in IT and systems administration. That path gave me a perspective I value: I don't naturally think about technology as isolated layers. I want to understand how the pieces connect and how the entire system can work better.
 
I'm curious by nature and especially interested in AI, automation, intelligent systems, digital twins, and the intersection between software and the physical world.
 
I don't need to know everything before I start. Give me an interesting problem worth figuring out.
 
Build boldly. Stay curious.

positions.title: IT Administrator
positions.description: I am a department of one. I am the only IT person at the company, constantly researching new technologies and evaluating business processes.

positions.title: Service Desk Support Technician
positions.description:
SUMMARY
Responsible for providing technical assistance and support related to computer systems, hardware, or software. Responds to queries, runs diagnostic programs, isolates problem, and determines and implements solution.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
Provide technical assistance and support for incoming queries and issues related to computer systems, software, and hardware.
Respond to queries either in person, through email or over the phone.
Write training manuals.
Train computer users.
Maintain daily performance of computer systems.
Respond to email messages for customers seeking help.
Ask questions to determine nature of problem.
Walk customer through problem-solving process.
Install, modify, and repair computer hardware and software.
Clean up computers.
Run diagnostic programs to resolve problems.
Resolve technical problems with Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and other systems.
Install computer peripherals for users.
Follow up with customers to ensure issue has been resolved.
Gain feedback from customers about computer usage.
Run reports to determine malfunctions that continue to occur.
Upgrade OS Windows XP to Windows 7
Support Tablet Users on Windows 8

volunteerExperiences.description: I worked as an IT consultant working with the LWV St.Paul to implement a system to store voter information. The information was collected from a Pledge To Vote form I helped to refine and make digital.
I am working on making a searchable database that can work with the hosts current technology.
